# Convert provisional overdose deaths to numeric while preserving suppressed values as missing
overdose_clean_pdf["Overdose_Deaths"] = pd.to_numeric(
    overdose_clean_pdf["Provisional Drug Overdose Deaths"],
    errors="coerce"
)

print(
    "Available overdose values:",
    overdose_clean_pdf["Overdose_Deaths"].notna().sum()
)

print(
    "Missing or suppressed overdose values:",
    overdose_clean_pdf["Overdose_Deaths"].isna().sum()
)

# Create an analysis-ready dataset containing records with both dispensing and overdose values available
analysis_pdf = merged_pdf.dropna(
    subset=[
        "Dispensing_Rate",
        "Overdose_Deaths"
    ]
).copy()

print("Complete merged dataset:", merged_pdf.shape)
print("Analysis-ready dataset:", analysis_pdf.shape)

# Count the number of usable county observations available for each year in the analysis-ready dataset
year_counts = (
    analysis_pdf["Year"]
    .value_counts()
    .sort_index()
)

print("Usable observations by year:")
print(year_counts)

# Perform final validation checks before using the cleaned and merged dataset for analysis
print(
    "Duplicate Year-FIPS records:",
    analysis_pdf.duplicated(
        subset=["Year", "FIPS"]
    ).sum()
)

print(
    "Missing dispensing rates:",
    analysis_pdf["Dispensing_Rate"].isna().sum()
)

print(
    "Missing overdose deaths:",
    analysis_pdf["Overdose_Deaths"].isna().sum()
)

print(
    "Number of unique counties:",
    analysis_pdf["FIPS"].nunique()
)

print(
    "Years represented:",
    sorted(analysis_pdf["Year"].unique())
)
